channel.description: Recent content in Posts on Vmmem

item.title: CVE-2024-44193: iTunes AppleMobileDeviceService Arbitrary File Deletion to SYSTEM
item.description: iTunes 12.13.2.3 AppleMobileDeviceService grants write access to Users in ProgramData, enabling NTFS junction redirect of a SYSTEM-privileged file deletion into a MSI rollback code execution chain

item.title: CVE-2021-21551: Dell dbutil_2_3.sys Arbitrary Kernel Memory R/W (BYOVD)
item.description: Analysis of arbitrary kernel memory read/write exposed by Dell's signed driver dbutil_2_3.sys due to missing IOCTL validation, and SYSTEM escalation via token stealing

item.title: CVE-2021-36934 SeriousSAM: Reading SAM Database as Unprivileged User
item.description: Analysis of the SeriousSAM vulnerability where incorrect ACLs on Windows SAM/SYSTEM files allow any local user to extract credential hashes via Volume Shadow Copies

item.title: CVE-2023-36424: Windows clfs.sys Kernel Pool Overflow LPE
item.description: Technical analysis of a kernel pool overflow in clfs.sys mini filter driver caused by insufficient validation of NTFS reparse point records, and full exploitation via pool grooming and ALPC handle overwrite

item.title: CVE-2024-21338: Windows AppLocker Driver LPE with HVCI Bypass
item.description: Analysis of CVE-2024-21338, a Windows AppLocker kernel driver vulnerability allowing Admin-to-Kernel escalation even with HVCI enabled via token manipulation
